pots.title: Biblically Accurate Freak Mug
pots.description: What is it? Freak Mug How did you make it? pinch and coil. What's on it? Slip, stain and glaze and sometimes underglaze What is the clay body? this is a pot made out of stoneware with porcelain teeth and multicolored porcelain eyeballs. Can I put it in the dishwasher or microwave? best not to Is this mug functional? Yes! my work is intended to be a functional sculpture. I want you to develop a relationship with the pot. that's the beauty of handmade work! How big is it? This mug holds 12oz
